purpose: raw (as-cast / as-forged) v finished (machined) drawing pairs for should-cost validation of casting+machining and forging+machining

entries.component: Crankcase, Automotive Stirling Engine Mod I (U-4 engine drive system)
entries.matchEvidence: Parent-child reference on the sheet: crankcase 1-61116 sheet 1 note sends the marked dimensions to 'DRG No 61108 (3274-108)' = title of 1-61108 'CRANKCASE/BEDPLATE MACHINING DRAWING' (internal no. 3274-108 in its title block). Both are listed together in the same Engine Drive System drawing list (PDF p.181). Vol I sec. 7.1.3 says crankcase and bedplate are castings (LPDC, initially sand cast).

entries.component: Bedplate (lower crankcase), Automotive Stirling Engine Mod I

Same drawing list (PDF p.181) and Vol I sec. 7.1.3.
